name: Palm
summary: A grand-hotel spa: a letterhead header (the clinic's name and street on the left, the pages as a small two-row index behind a palm hairline on the right, a palm-green rule beneath); one large daylit photograph of a facial in an ivory frame; then "How does your skin feel today?" with five words, answered by a printed treatment card (palm border, one fine gold line) in the clinic's own words. Ivory ground, Antic Didone for the name, the question and the treatments, Baskervville for everything else, roman only. For facialists, skin clinics and hotel-style beauty rooms.
